Retrieve iNaturalist photographs

Source: R/inat_images.R
inat_images.Rd

Finds observations for a scientific name or observation identifier and returns their licensed photographs with taxonomic, observer, locality, source, and caption metadata. Results are ordered by observed date, newest first; records without an observed date follow dated records. The default search uses Research Grade observations that contain photographs and retains photos with Creative Commons licenses that permit attribution. Captions cite the photo license and link to the observation page.

inat_images(
  species = NULL,
  user_id = NULL,
  number_observations = 1L,
  observation_id = NULL,
  image_size = c(.sacha_inat_defaults$default_image_size, setdiff(c("medium", "large",
    "original", "small", "square"), .sacha_inat_defaults$default_image_size)),
  source = c("web", "local"),
  verify_local = FALSE,
  images_directory = .sacha_inat_defaults$default_images_directory,
  quality_grade = .sacha_inat_defaults$default_quality_grade,
  place_id = NULL,
  catalogue_dataset = .sacha_inat_defaults$catalogue_dataset,
  language = .inat_language_choices(preferred = .sacha_inat_defaults$language),
  observer_name = NULL,
  save_images = FALSE,
  export_comp = FALSE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

inat_images_md(
  species = NULL,
  user_id = NULL,
  number_observations = 1L,
  observation_id = NULL,
  image_size = c(.sacha_inat_defaults$default_image_size, setdiff(c("medium", "large",
    "original", "small", "square"), .sacha_inat_defaults$default_image_size)),
  source = c("web", "local"),
  verify_local = FALSE,
  images_directory = .sacha_inat_defaults$default_images_directory,
  quality_grade = .sacha_inat_defaults$default_quality_grade,
  place_id = NULL,
  catalogue_dataset = .sacha_inat_defaults$catalogue_dataset,
  language = .inat_language_choices(preferred = .sacha_inat_defaults$language),
  observer_name = NULL,
  save_images = FALSE,
  export_comp = FALSE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  ncol = 2L,
  word_subfigure_width = "3in",
  latex_subfigure_width = "86%"
)

Arguments

species

Optional scientific name, normally written as "Genus species". Supply either species or observation_id.

user_id

Optional iNaturalist login used to restrict a species search. NULL includes observations from all users.

number_observations

Positive integer giving the maximum number of observations to retrieve; defaults to 1.

observation_id

Optional numeric observation identifier or vector. When supplied with species, each observation is checked against that taxon. When supplied alone, all IDs must refer to one taxon.

image_size

Image variant: medium (default), large, original, small, or square.

source

"web" queries the API; "local" uses only images and metadata previously saved under images_directory/sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/inat.

verify_local

If TRUE, use a complete local archive first and query the API only when the archive cannot satisfy the request.

images_directory

Base directory under which the package creates or searches sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/inat. Defaults to the working directory. Existing archives in the former images directory and earlier taxon-directory layout remain readable when using the default path.

quality_grade

iNaturalist observation quality filter. "research" (default) excludes casual observations; "needs_id" selects observations awaiting community identification. Valid API values are research, needs_id, and casual.

place_id

Optional numeric iNaturalist place identifier.

catalogue_dataset

ChecklistBank dataset identifier used to obtain taxonomic authorship.

language

Caption language. English is the default; Spanish and other installed inst/lang language files are also accepted.

observer_name

Optional replacement for the iNaturalist observer name in captions.

save_images

If TRUE, download and save the selected photographs and JSON metadata to sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/inat, using the same layout as inat_save_images(). Saved images are immediately available to source = "local" and verify_local = TRUE.

export_comp

If TRUE, save only the PNG composition to sacha_exports/Family_Genus_species/inat. This does not save source photographs or their metadata. The optional magick package is also needed for the composition preview.

refresh

If TRUE, bypass cached API results.

ncol

Number of columns in a Markdown panel and exported composition; default 2.

word_subfigure_width

Width of DOCX subfigures; default "3in".

latex_subfigure_width

Width of PDF/LaTeX subfigures; default "86%".

Value

inat_images() returns the selected observations and their image metadata. Printing the result shows a concise observation summary. inat_images_md() invisibly returns the same metadata object after emitting figure markup for a Markdown document.

Details

Photo and observation licenses are separate iNaturalist fields. This function filters and reports the license attached to each photo; it does not infer a photo's reuse terms from the observation license. The default accepted photo licenses are CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, CC BY-ND, and CC BY-NC-ND. Follow all license conditions, including attribution, non-commercial use, share-alike, and no-derivatives terms.

Searches use the iNaturalist API v2 and request observations with photos. Results are paged in batches of at most 200. For requests exceeding 10,000 observations, ascending ID order and the id_above cursor avoid the API page limit. Requests in extended searches are separated by at least 1.02 seconds. iNaturalist recommends about one request per second and warns that media downloads above 5 GB per hour or 24 GB per day may result in a permanent block. The default session thresholds are 4.5 GB per hour and 21.5 GB per day; they can be adjusted within the API's stated limits with sacha_configure(). Accounting is per R session and cannot include downloads from other processes or machines using the same network. See https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices and https://api.inaturalist.org/v2/docs/.

References

iNaturalist API recommended practices: https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices. iNaturalist API v2 reference: https://api.inaturalist.org/v2/docs/. iNaturalist search filters and photo licenses: https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/search+urls. iNaturalist guidance on photo use and attribution: https://help.inaturalist.org/en/support/solutions/articles/151000169918.

Captions identify the scientific name, locality, observation date, observer, photo licence, and observation URL. The licence applies to the photograph; the linked URL identifies the observation. In Markdown output, one figure groups the selected observations for a taxon and each observation has its own subfigure caption. The Quarto figure ID is fig-taxon-<taxon_id>; each subfigure ID is fig-sub-<observation_id>. The taxon ID is resolved from the observations and is taken from the returned observations. For example, after rendering Bidens andicola, use @fig-taxon-<resolved_taxon_id> to refer to its panel, or @fig-sub-<observation_id> to refer to one observation. The generated caption is language-dependent; its English form follows the pattern Bidens andicola ... observed in <locality> on dd/mm/yyyy, by <observer> (Licence: <photo licence>). <observation URL>. In Quarto or R Markdown, set results: asis on the chunk that calls inat_images_md() so the figure markup is rendered and its IDs can be referenced from the document.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inat_images("Bidens andicola")
inat_images("Bidens andicola", user_id = "observer_login",
            place_id = 1234, number_observations = 5,
            image_size = "large", source = "web")
inat_images("Bidens andicola", save_images = TRUE, export_comp = TRUE)
inat_images("Bidens andicola", source = "local")
inat_images("Bidens andicola", verify_local = TRUE, place_id = 1234)
inat_images("Bidens andicola", quality_grade = "needs_id",
            observer_name = "Observer name", language = "en",
            images_directory = ".", refresh = TRUE,
            catalogue_dataset = "3LXR")
inat_images(observation_id = 123456, image_size = "original")
} # }
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola")
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola", number_observations = 4,
               source = "web", ncol = 2)
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola", user_id = "observer_login",
               place_id = 1234, number_observations = 3,
               image_size = "large", language = "en")
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola", observation_id = 123456,
               source = "web", save_images = TRUE)
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola", source = "local",
               verify_local = FALSE, export_comp = TRUE, ncol = 2)
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola", verify_local = TRUE,
               number_observations = 2, save_images = TRUE,
               word_subfigure_width = "3in",
               latex_subfigure_width = "86%")
inat_images_md("Bidens andicola", quality_grade = "needs_id",
               observer_name = "Observer name", images_directory = ".",
               refresh = TRUE, catalogue_dataset = "3LXR",
               export_comp = TRUE, ncol = 1)
} # }
